newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo files for 6.6 million shares.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo files for 6.6 million shares.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 6,557,280 common shares.
Of the total amount, 5,245,824 shares are being offering in the United States and 1,311,456 common shares are being offered internationally.
All the shares offered are being sold by Supermarket Operators of America Inc, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Supervalu Inc, ShopKo said in the filing.

The offerings are a condition for the company's repurchase of 8,174,387 shares from the selling shareholder at $18.35 per share and all of such transactions are expected to be consummated simultaneously, Shopko said in the filing.
After the offerings and the stock buyback, Supervalu and its subsidiary will not benefically own any common of the company, the filing said.

The company has granted the U.S. underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 786,874 common shares. The company granted the international underwriters a similar option with respect to an additional 196,718 shares.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and Salomon Brothers.
If any of the stock is sold in connection with the underwriters overallotment option, the company will use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes.
ShopKo, based in Green Bay, Wisc., is a regional retailer which operates 130 retail stores and four free standing optical centers in 16 Upper Midwest, Pacific Northwest and Western Mountain states.
